value.rationale: Unoriented crossing of point pairs on a circular order is a natural geometric four-place structure, and rank five first detects nontrivial positional gap organization beyond the quartets. The precise fifteen-class theorem and sharp finite testing bound classify the full infinite family. It separates this low-depth invariant from that of oriented cyclic order and of adjacency cycles, without relying on arbitrary selected parameters or a narrow numerical curiosity.
